summary: Component L4 of ADR-0142 (plan D7). Today fixAgentModel marks the tier fixed and overlayTier drops every tier overlay (go/internal/cliroute/resolve.go:70, :126), which turns off the raises of ADR-0096 and ADR-0076 for build and tdd. Add a cliroute step after overlayTier that applies the ladder rung, ignores modelFixed, clamps to max_tier and max_effort, and keeps the allowed set and the family floor (profiles/family_floor.go). The first-attempt advisor overlay still respects the pin. evolve cli-routing set validates the two new keys. Spec docs/architecture/retry-ladder.md §5 and §7; ADR-0142.
